items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: The first of May, the Milliner-Littlejohn sextet and myself became the first jazz group to do a concert... inscribed: 'To Bill, with admiration and affection from the Boys - Tony, Alan, Matt, Lew, Mal & Dave'.

ctx.x: The first of May, the Milliner-Littlejohn sextet and myself became the first jazz group to do a concert in the Purcell Room which adjoins the Royal Festival Hall. This was a swell place, and I could sing without a mike which is something, because I don't have a very strong voice as far as singing is concerned. It was one of the most successful concerts and another first in my career.

Next we played Hitchen, Haywards Heath, Blackpool and finished the tour in Manchester at the Sports Guild. Buck's condition had improved and he was booked at play this last concert with me, but he had another haemorrhage and could not make the date. The sextet surprised me with a different of silver beer mug from the one the Bruce Turner boys gave me. This one was inscribed: 'To Bill, with admiration and affection from the Boys - Tony, Alan, Matt, Lew, Mal & Dave'. They also gave Lily a small one inscribed: 'To…
Lily and I visited friends in Scotland, We had a lot of fun with those whiskey lovers, went back to Steyning again, and returned to France the 16th of May.
